name: 雪球文章爬取
description: 爬取一篇雪球帖子/文章的全文（标题+正文，最多8000字符）。需浏览器已有雪球登录态。

inputs.name: url
inputs.description: 雪球帖子链接（xueqiu.com/<uid>/<postid>）；不填则在当前标签页爬取

body.name: js

args.expression: (async()=>{const want=(p)=>{p=(p||'').trim();return (!p||p[0]==='$')?'':p;};const target=want('$url');const isArt=()=>/xueqiu\.com\/\d+\/\d+/.test(location.href);if(target&&location.href!==target&&!isArt()){location.href=target;const t0=Date.now();while(Date.now()-t0<20000&&!isArt())await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500));}if(!isArt())return {ok:false,error:'not-article-page',hint:'请传入雪球帖子链接（xueqiu.com/<用户id>/<帖子id>），或在帖子页上直接运行'};await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1500));const body=document.querySelector('.article__bd__detail');if(!body)return {ok:false,error:'no-content',hint:'正文未渲染、需登录或无权限访问'};const h=document.querySelector('h1');const author=(document.querySelector('.article__bd__hd .user-name, .user-name')||{}).textContent||'';const pubTime=(document.body.innerText.match(/发布于[^\n]{5,30}/)||[''])[0];const pid=(location.href.match(/\/(\d+)\/(\d+)/)||[])[2];let engagement=null;try{const api=await fetch('https://xueqiu.com/statuses/show.json?id='+pid,{credentials:'include'}).then(r=>r.json());const dd=api.data||api;if(dd&&dd.like_count!==undefined)engagement={likes:dd.like_count||0,replies:dd.reply_count||0,retweets:dd.retweet_count||0};}catch{}return {ok:true,title:((h?h.textContent.trim():'')||document.title.split('_')[0].split('-')[0].trim()),author:author.trim().slice(0,40)||null,pubTime:pubTime||null,engagement:engagement,content:body.innerText.slice(0,8000),url:location.href};})()

body.note: 提取正文 + 作者/发布时间 + show.json 接口的互动数（likes/replies/retweets）
